law_text: Upon the immediate approach of an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency, making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of every other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: Yield the right-of-way.
